MEISTER — Gated Advanced Intermediate Open Play
DUPR 3.75+
Fast hands, real strategy, points worth watching.
Games to 11, win by 2
Paddle-rack rotation, no holding courts
Please be honest about your rating — players outside the range may be moved
Reserve online and check in at the front desk
Please cancel outside of 4 hours or contact the club
Members are charged a no-show fee for missed reservations without contacting club prior
Non-marking court shoes required
No outside food or drink — café open during all sessions
